name: degen_t08
hypothesis: The 55.8% degenerate-repetition rate of SFT v2 (vs base 0-shot 24.7%, base 3-shot 6.6%) is produced by greedy decoding, not by the model. READ: degeneracy at t=0.8 below base's 24.7% => the loop is a decoding artifact and every greedy code-500 number today is measuring the decoder; at or above 55.8% => the model itself is non-terminating and the cause is upstream in the SFT data or recipe. Accuracy at t=0.8 is a different estimator than greedy and is NOT comparable to the 2.2%.
finding: The repetition loop is a greedy-decoding artifact: sampling at t=0.8 cuts degeneracy by two thirds, below base 0-shot's 25.4%. It hid nothing -- accuracy stayed on the floor and in fact fell (greedy is the better pass@1 estimator for a weak model). So the format-side numbers (fence rate, degeneracy) are properties of the decoder and must be reported with their temperature; the capability-side number (accuracy at the floor) is decoder-independent and now rests on firmer ground, having been suspected of being a decoder artifact and checked.
decision: Report every generative format metric with its temperature; do not build a repetition penalty (it would suppress a symptom that carries no capability signal); do not change the SFT recipe or the SFT pack on this evidence. The 200M-has-no-measurable-code-generation conclusion stands.

name: degen_t08_base
hypothesis: Control arm for degen_t08, missing from the original design: base 0-shot code-500 was scored greedy (0/497, degeneracy 25.4%). If greedy also suppresses base accuracy, the 'no measurable code generation at 200M' conclusion rests partly on a decoder artifact. READ: base t=0.8 accuracy still 0/497 (or below 12.6%) => the capability conclusion is decoder-independent and stands. Above 12.6% => every base code number today measured the decoder and the conclusion is void.
finding: The control arm the original design was missing. Sampling halves degeneracy on the base model too and moves accuracy not at all -- it was already exactly zero and stays exactly zero. So the capability conclusion is decoder-independent: across two checkpoints and two temperatures, every code accuracy sits on the floor while the degeneracy rate moves by 13-39 points. Degeneracy and accuracy are separate channels and only the first responds to the decoder.
decision: '200M has no measurable code generation in this regime' is confirmed and no longer needs the decoder caveat. Report generative FORMAT metrics with their temperature; capability metrics do not need it.
